recognize_zh: 骨髓切片高倍下幾乎全為核卵圓至不規則、染色質淡、有小核仁的未成熟細胞成片分布，正常成熟造血細胞稀少；中央可見細胞質粉紅、核分葉彼此分離的異常巨核細胞，在有化療史者提示治療相關髓系腫瘤。
features: Hypercellular marrow with sheets of immature cells replacing normal hematopoiesis
Medium to large cells with oval, folded or irregular nuclei, vesicular chromatin and small nucleoli
Moderate amount of pale eosinophilic to amphophilic cytoplasm
Scattered megakaryocyte with widely separated nuclear lobes (center)
Few residual erythroid precursors and eosinophilic granulocytes; interstitial red cells and hemosiderin
describe_en: Bone marrow trephine core biopsy is hypercellular with sheets of immature cells that have oval to irregular, focally folded nuclei, vesicular chromatin, small nucleoli and moderate pale cytoplasm, with only scattered residual erythroid and granulocytic elements. A megakaryocyte with widely separated nuclear lobes is present near the center, a dysplastic feature. There is focal hemosiderin pigment. In a patient with prior cytotoxic therapy, findings are consistent with therapy-related acute myeloid leukemia.

ddx.dx: De novo AML with myelodysplasia-related changes
ddx.vs: Morphology is identical; the therapy-related designation rests on documented prior cytotoxic chemotherapy or radiation.

ddx.dx: Marrow involvement by large cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: Lymphoma cells are lymphoid-marker positive (CD20/CD3) and lack associated megakaryocytic dysplasia; immunostains separate them.
Regeneration shows synchronized waves of maturing myeloid and erythroid cells with normal megakaryocytes, not persistent sheets of blasts with dysplastic megakaryocytes.
